text:
sara: Hey — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/4123 touches ops-api/handlers and infra/configs/nginx.conf. CODEOWNERS lists @eng-platform and @eng-infra. This is blocking the rollout scheduled in 2 hours, who can sign off? :woozy_face:

ben: Link received. Quick question — is this purely a dependency bump + config tweak or does it change runtime behavior? If just bump + nginx tweak we normally need 1 owner from each CODEOWNERS group.

sara: It's a dep bump for the ops-api client (minor semver) and a small nginx header add for routing. No API surface change. I've included tests and staging run results in the PR.

alex: Morning — since both dirs are owned by different teams, policy says we need approvals from each owning team unless the change is limited-scope. In practice for infra+app chores we can use the oncall fallback: oncall + one owner OR 2 owners. Who's oncall for eng-infra? @li ?

li: I'm on infra oncall until 17:00. I can review the nginx snippet now. If it's just adding a header + no rewrite, :thumbsup: I can approve infra side.

ben: Great — I can review ops-api part. If we both approve, merge-bot will allow merging. Otherwise we can ask a lead for an override. Also FYI there's an existing owner-rotation window today — double-checking owners.yml might be stale.

merge-bot: merge attempt blocked — required approvals missing: @eng-platform, @eng-infra. Use `?override` label with lead approval for emergency merges.

sara: @li @ben thanks. I'll attach a short changelog + expand the PR description for the lead. Ben — ping me if you need tests explained.

ben: Reviewing now, will comment in 15.

alex: For posterity, if overlap like this becomes common we should consider adding an OWNERS file in ops-api allowing a single team proxy for infra-chore-only changes. Filing a tiny RFC after this.

sara: Sounds good. For this rollout, approving now from both sides should be enough. Thanks all. :rocket:
